description: This is a C++ test source file for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, part of a core library, using the Google Test framework to verify string processing functionalities.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a string fragment with methods for string manipulation and comparison.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment based on delimiters.

methods.name: BorderFragment
methods.description: Creates a TextFragment object initialized with a string buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next segment.

methods.name: Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining segment of the text.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the position of delimiter in the text fragment.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment matches a marker.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Checks if the fragment has the same text as the provided buffer.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims the beginning of the fragment based on a marker.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims the end of the fragment based on a marker.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds a substring starting from the end.
